questions.question: What does the device do (e.g. generate or convert electric power, produce heat, or transmit or receive communications)?
questions.why: Headings within chapter 85 split by function (motors and generators, transformers, switching or protecting apparatus, communication apparatus, domestic appliances).

candidates.rationale: Heading 8517 61 covers base stations for networks, which a dock is not, though it does have some networking (Ethernet) ports.

coverage.hint: No national catalog is enabled for FR; lookups answer at HS6 (6 digits) only. See GET /v2/customs/coverage/countries.
